title: Fred Reed's letter on relandscaping the mesa

tellings.quote: They came basically to rellandscape the the uh mesa.

plain: A man named Fred Reed wrote in a letter dated March 27, 1999, that a team came to the mesa at Hart Canyon near Aztec, New Mexico, where a flying saucer is said to have crashed in 1948, in order to relandscape it. Scott Ramsey, a researcher who has spent years on the Aztec crash, tells Michels about the letter, saying the crew came "basically to relandscape the mesa." If true, it would mean the site was deliberately cleaned up to hide what happened there.
